slides.texte_overlay:
Small habits that keep
your home clean without effort
Never leave a room empty-handed. Take a cup to the kitchen, a jacket to the hook. Tiny trips stop clutter from piling up.
Wash dishes right after eating. Five minutes now saves thirty later. A clean kitchen makes the whole home feel calmer.
Make your bed every morning. The biggest surface in your bedroom done in a minute. The room instantly looks tidy.
Do a ten-minute reset every evening. Music on, put everything back where it belongs. Waking up to a tidy home feels great.
Before: chores felt endless and boring. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I listen to new ideas while I tidy.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: chores felt endless and boring. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I now learn while I tidy.

slides.texte_overlay: Have a home for everything. Keys, chargers, documents. When everything has a place, tidying takes no thought. Start with keys.
Own less. Fewer things means less to clean, store and lose. A simple home is the easiest home to keep clean. Less is easier.
